title: Takes forever to empty. Freezes hands
text: Takes forever to empty. Freezes hands. So these are cute & all but SO hard to remove ice compared to traditional ice trays. You have to literally push each individual cube out (you cannot bend this to break apart the ice so it falls out naturally like you would with a traditional one because it will crack) so you’re holding on to a freezing ice tray with both hands while you push each one out(and the base is silicone so it doesn’t slide out like it would with plastic- you have to physically push each one out which takes a while when you’re holding something that’s freezing cold. I can’t empty more than one tray without my hands turning white. 100% do not recommend

features: 【Easy Ice Release & Clean】--The flexible silicone material shapes the bottom well, make it easy to release ice cubes. Smooth silicone surface makes it easy to clean.
